site.name: Experiments
site.author: Varna Sri Raman
site.home_tagline: Tools that show their working: econometrics, poverty measurement, survey auditing, women and climate data, and legal calculators.

tools.name: Causal Inference Workbench
tools.tagline: Difference-in-differences, event studies and synthetic control, computed in your browser.

tools.name: Poverty & Inequality Explorer
tools.tagline: Gini, Theil, Atkinson and FGT poverty measures from grouped data or the World Bank.

tools.name: Wage Gap Decomposition
tools.tagline: Oaxaca–Blinder decomposition of the gender wage gap, with bootstrap standard errors.

tools.name: Women in the NFHS
tools.tagline: Women's health, work, assets, agency and safety across India's states and NFHS rounds.

tools.name: Heat and Outdoor Work
tools.tagline: Hour-by-hour heat stress for outdoor workers, safe working hours and wages lost, for any place in India.

tools.name: RCT Planner
tools.tagline: Power and minimum detectable effect for individual and cluster trials, and a seeded randomiser.

tools.name: Survey Data Auditor
tools.tagline: Field-data checks for surveys: duplicates, Benford's law, age heaping and enumerator profiles.

tools.name: Cost–Benefit Calculator
tools.tagline: NPV, benefit–cost ratio, IRR and cost per outcome for a programme, with Monte Carlo uncertainty.

tools.name: Motor Accident Compensation Calculator
tools.tagline: Fatal motor accident compensation under the Motor Vehicles Act, with the authority for each step.

tools.name: Land Acquisition Compensation Calculator
tools.tagline: Compensation and rehabilitation under the 2013 Land Acquisition Act, with the section on each line.

tools.name: Court Petition Translator
tools.tagline: Hindi Supreme Court and High Court petitions translated into formal legal English.

tools.name: Election Expenditure Ledger
tools.tagline: A candidate's election spending against the Election Commission ceiling.

tools.name: Manifesto Promise Costing
tools.tagline: Manifesto promises costed against a state's budget, with low and high ranges.

tools.name: Statutory Interest Calculator
tools.tagline: Interest the way Indian statutes prescribe it, from MSMED Act section 16 to cheque-bounce compensation.

tools.name: A Year of Air
tools.tagline: A year of PM2.5 and PM10 for any place in India, against the WHO guideline and India's standard.

tools.name: Petition Builder
tools.tagline: A representation or petition to an Indian authority, drafted in the accepted form. Nothing leaves the browser.

tools.name: Court Filing Formatter
tools.tagline: A Word document reformatted to an Indian court's filing rules, with each circular quoted.

tools.name: Flipbook Maker
tools.tagline: A PDF turned into a page-turning flipbook that works offline. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: Kundendu's Learn & Play
tools.tagline: Class 1 CBSE worksheets in English, Hindi, Maths and EVS, with fresh questions every time.

tools.name: Agastya's Study Lab
tools.tagline: Year-round revision for CBSE Class 8: mind maps, notes, practice, worksheets and a mock paper.

tools.name: Household Library Builder
tools.tagline: The books in a house catalogued by ISBN or title, with who is reading and who has borrowed what.
